newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stock prices mixed in nervous trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stock prices mixed in nervous trade.

text.p: The Estonian bourse on Tuesday was busy with stocks mixed and the market nervous, dealers said.
Total volume on the official list was 79 million kroons and the index closed down 0.36 percent on 251.92.
Forekspank was the most traded stock with 29.9 million kroons of shares changing hands. The stock lost 5.80 kroons to close on 184.70 kroons.
"Dealers are at odds whether the stock is over-valued or under-valued so it varied greatly today," one trader said.
Hoiupank saw trade of 16.6 million kroons of shares to end 1.75 kroons higher on 126.75 kroons.
Hansapank was lightly traded on 10.6 million kroons of shares changing hands. It shed 3.50 kroons to 256.50 kroons.
On the free market, total trade was 13.6 million kroons of shares, with Rakvere meat plant the most active stock.
Rakvere turned over 4.4 million kroons of shares to close 0.10 kroons lower at 16.15 kroons.
